text: dsh-zotero（DSH Web 插件）：把 Zotero 文献库接入对话与文献面板。核心组件注册检索、条目读取、批量读取、引用匹配、全文证据提取、浏览、导出和变更追踪工具；可选文献面板提供集合浏览、筛选、条目详情和引用复制，另有默认关闭的学术检索组件，可搜索多个学术索引、读取全文并核验引文。适合在 DSH 中查找、阅读、引用和维护 Zotero 文献的研究者；需要本机 Zotero Local API，写入工具需显式启用，学术检索需启用对应组件。

dsh-zotero (DSH web plugin) connects Zotero to conversations and a literature panel. It supports library search, item reading, full-text evidence, citation export, change tracking, and optional scholarly search. It requires Zotero Local API access; writes and external scholarly search are opt-in.

Zotero 文献检索：按元数据或笔记内容搜索个人库、群组库或指定范围，并返回匹配条目。由 DSH 工具调用触发，输入查询和范围，输出条目结果。
全文证据提取：从指定 Zotero 文献附件读取文本并按相关度挑选片段，供对话引用论文内容。由检索工具调用触发，输入文献引用和查询，输出证据段落。
引用与书目导出：将指定文献导出为 citation、bibliography、BibTeX、BibLaTeX、RIS、CSL-JSON 或 CSV。由导出工具调用，输出格式化文本或结构化数据。

文献变更追踪：读取 Zotero 库在指定版本范围内的变化并返回变更摘要。由变更工具调用触发，输入版本范围与过滤条件，输出变化条目。
学术索引检索：在可选 scholarly 组件启用后，可搜索 arXiv、Crossref、OpenAlex、Semantic Scholar、Europe PMC、PubMed 和 DBLP，并获取论文、引文关系及全文阅读结果。

English · 中文

dsh-zotero 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地 Zotero 插件。Agent 在对话里检索、阅读、引用并按需修改文献库；你在文献面板里浏览整个库并复制引用；文献轨迹展示 Agent 在当前会话中查到的文献、原文片段与导出内容，方便核对。 所有操作均通过 Zotero 本地 API（`127.0.0.1:23119`）与桌面端交互，读取无需配置 API Key。

dsh-zotero README · 主要功能：- **对话检索**
  - 检索阅读：按标题、作者、年份或全文搜索文献，读取元数据、个人笔记与本地 PDF 全文。
  - 原文定位：围绕具体问题从全文、批注和笔记中提取相关段落，PDF 批注附带原始页码。
  - 引用导出：按 CSL 样式生成行内引用或参考文献表，支持导出 BibTeX、RIS 与 CSL-JSON。
  - 写入扩展（可选）：开启后可创建笔记、修改标签与合集（每次均需会话审批）；启用学术检索组件后可跨 7 个外部索引检索文献并核验引用。
- **文献轨迹**
  - 检索记录：会话顶部首屏显示每次调用的查询词、范围、筛选条件与命中数。
  - 原文核对：按文献条目整理提取出的段落与批注，标明出处与原始页码，方便核对。
  - 导出汇总：跨条目汇总当前会话生成的所有引用与 BibTeX，自动去重，可直接复制或下载。
- **文献面板**
  - 全库浏览：在右侧边栏浏览 Zotero 合集树、标签、保存的搜索与回收站，支持多条件组合筛选。
  - 详情与阅读：查看条目元数据、关联笔记与附件列表，支持在右侧阅读栏直接打开本地 PDF。
  - 引用与联动：动作行直接复制 BibTeX、CSL 引用或条目信息；支持将选中文献一键填入对话输入框。

dsh-zotero README · 前置条件：1. 安装并运行 Zotero 7 及以上桌面版（写入功能需 Zotero 10）。
2. 在 Zotero 中开启本地 API：**设置 → 高级 → 勾选“允许此计算机上的其他应用程序与 Zotero 通信”**。

dsh-zotero README · 1. 在对话中研读与定位出处：- **文献检索与问答**：向 Agent 询问某个研究方向，Agent 检索本地文献库，结合文献摘要与元数据生成回答。
  ```text
  Agent → zotero_search(query: "Risk", itemTypes: ["journalArticle"])
  ```
- **定位原文段落**：深入追问论文细节，Agent 从本地 PDF 全文与批注中提取相关段落，并附带原始页码标注。
  ```text
  Agent → zotero_retrieve(ref: "zotero://user/0/item/ABCD1234", query: "methodology", sources: ["annotation", "fulltext"])
  ```
- **生成标准引用**：要求格式化输出时，Agent 直接生成 BibTeX 条目或指定样式的 CSL 引用。
  ```text
  Agent → zotero_export(refs: ["zotero://user/0/item/ABCD1234"], format: "bibtex")
  ```

中文 · English

dsh-zotero is a local Zotero plugin for DeepSeek Harness. The agent searches, reads, cites, and (optionally) modifies the library in conversation; you browse the whole library and copy citations in the literature panel; the literature trail gathers the papers, passages, and exports from the session for verification. All operations interact with Zotero through its local API (`127.0.0.1:23119`). Reads need no API key.

dsh-zotero README · Features：- **Conversation & Retrieval**
  - Search & reading: Search papers by title, author, year, or full text, and read bibliographic metadata, notes, and local PDF full text.
  - Passage extraction: Locate relevant passages across full text, notes, and annotations for specific research questions, with original page numbers preserved on PDF annotations.
  - Citation & export: Generate in-text citations or bibliographies in specified CSL styles, and export BibTeX, RIS, or CSL-JSON.
  - Writing & extensions (optional): With write access enabled, create notes and update tags or collections (each write requires approval); with the scholarly component enabled, search across seven external indexes and verify references.
- **Literature Trail**
  - Search history: The session header shows query terms, scopes, filter conditions, and hit counts for every tool call on the first screen.
  - Passage review: Review extracted passages and annotations grouped by paper, complete with source tags and page numbers for easy verification.
  - Export collection: Review all citations and BibTeX entries generated in the conversation, deduplicated across items and ready to copy or do
dsh-zotero README · Features：For details on interaction patterns, UI roles, and runtime boundaries, see the [product model](docs/product-model.en.md).

Start a new session after installation. Open the **dsh-zotero** detail page in the plugin manager; its configuration section carries the full configuration form.

> Note: Installing directly from the `main` source branch needs a local build. pnpm blocks dependency builds by default, so use the `#release` branch to skip build configuration and install directly.

dsh-zotero README · Prerequisites：1. Zotero 7 or newer desktop app installed (writes require Zotero 10).
2. Enable the local API in Zotero: **Settings → Advanced → check "Allow other applications on this computer to communicate with Zotero"**.

dsh-zotero README · 1. Research and trace citations in conversation：Ask questions about your research topics directly in chat. The agent automatically retrieves items from your local Zotero library, reads full texts, and extracts passages with original page numbers:
section: 1. Research and trace citations in conversation

text:
dsh-zotero README · 1. Research and trace citations in conversation：- **Literature search & QA**: Ask the agent about a research direction; the agent searches your local library and synthesizes answers using abstracts and metadata.
  ```text
  Agent → zotero_search(query: "Risk", itemTypes: ["journalArticle"])
  ```
- **Locate original passages**: Ask deeper questions about paper details; the agent extracts relevant passages from local PDF full text and annotations, with original page numbers attached.
  ```text
  Agent → zotero_retrieve(ref: "zotero://user/0/item/ABCD1234", query: "methodology", sources: ["annotation", "fulltext"])
  ```
- **Generate formatted citations**: Ask for formatted outputs; the agent generates BibTeX entries or CSL citations in your requested style.
  ```text
  Agent → zotero_export(refs: ["zotero://user/0/item/ABCD1234"], format: "bibtex")
  ```
section: 1. Research and trace citations in conversation

text: dsh-zotero README · 2. Verify sources and export in the literature trail：After a conversation, click the **Literature Trail** tab at the top of the session to inspect and verify all references used in that session:
section: 2. Verify sources and export in the literature trail

text:
dsh-zotero README · 2. Verify sources and export in the literature trail：- **Review search criteria**: The overview screen displays every query term, search scope (whole library, collection, or saved search), filter conditions, and hit count invoked during the session.
- **Inspect sources item by item**: Check extracted passages against original page numbers and annotations in the item inspector to ensure every cited point is grounded in the source.
- **Deduplicated export aggregation**: Review all citations and BibTeX entries produced during the session in the Export view, automatically deduplicated across items and ready for one-click copying or downloading.
section: 2. Verify sources and export in the literature trail

text: dsh-zotero README · 3. Browse, read, and cite in the literature panel：When writing papers or organizing literature independently, use the **Literature Panel** in the right sidebar without going through chat:
section: 3. Browse, read, and cite in the literature panel

text:
dsh-zotero README · 3. Browse, read, and cite in the literature panel：- **Independent browsing & filtering**: Browse the collection tree, tag system, saved searches, and Trash, with combined filtering by publication year and item type.
- **Inspect details & read PDFs**: Click any item to inspect metadata and associated notes, or open the local PDF directly in the reading pane.
- **Instant citations & chat handoff**: Click "Copy BibTeX" or "Copy citation" in the action row to paste directly into your manuscript; click "Ask" or "Add to chat" to send selected references into the chat draft for targeted discussions.
